SourceProxy.name: RadialDistanceDenoise
SourceProxy.label: Senfoto008 Radial Distance Denoise

Documentation.short_help: Two-level radial-distance denoise for Senfoto008 point clouds
Documentation.long_help: Level1: cross-frame radial distance diff keyed by (laser_id, azimuth bin). Level2: same-frame, same laser line, left-mid-right interpolation.

SourceProxy.Documentation: Two-level radial-distance denoise for Senfoto008. Uses the fixed per-point arrays distance_m (radial slant range), laser_id and azimuth (degrees). Level 1 compares each point's radial distance with the previous frame at the same (laser_id, azimuth bin); Level 2 compares each point on a laser line with the linear interpolation of its left/right neighbors.

IntVectorProperty.name: Number of lasers
IntVectorProperty.Documentation: Number of laser lines; buckets are auto-extended to the max id seen.

DoubleVectorProperty.name: Azimuth bin size
DoubleVectorProperty.Documentation: Level 1 azimuth bin size in degrees for the (laser_id, bin) cache key.
